class Chan:
    cap: int
    items: list[int]

def full(c: Chan) -> bool:
    """True when the channel holds cap items and cannot accept a send."""
    ex full(Chan(cap=1, items=[4])) == True
    ex full(Chan(cap=2, items=[4])) == False
    return c.items.len() >= c.cap

def offer(c: Chan, v: int) -> Chan:
    """Return the channel after appending v if there is room, else unchanged."""
    pre c.cap >= 0
    post out.items.len() <= out.cap
    ex offer(Chan(cap=1, items=[]), 7) == Chan(cap=1, items=[7])
    ex offer(Chan(cap=1, items=[7]), 8) == Chan(cap=1, items=[7])
    if full(c):
        return c
    return Chan(cap=c.cap, items=c.items + [v])

def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Count how many sends from xs are accepted into a channel of capacity cap before it becomes full. Sending stops at the first rejected send. Examples: with cap 2 and xs [1, 2, 3] the result is 2; with cap 0 and xs [1, 2] it is 0; with cap 5 and an empty xs it is 0."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post 0 <= out and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
    ch = Chan(cap=cap, items=[])
    count = 0
    for v in xs:
        if full(ch):
            break
        ch = offer(ch, v)
        count += 1
    return count
